searchText: Is there any general consensus yet for what Glamsterdam will be focusing on? It definitely seems that what the community wants is some hard forks focused on L1 improvements in terms of both scalability & functionality. Not sure about general consensus, but there is direction: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/745077610685661265/1363658409492090930 Yes it very non-specific. I do think for Glamsterdam, to improve not just UX but narrative for Ethereum L1, we need to see a slot times reduction from the current 12s. Ideally cut that in half to 6s if it technically feasible and safe.
